answer: Push-ups, Incline Dumbbell Press, or Dumbbell Chest Press make excellent alternatives targeting the chest and triceps.
For a gym-based biceps session, combine heavy Barbell Curls, Dumbbell Hammer Curls, Cable Curls, and Preacher Curls.
Top dumbbell shoulder exercises include Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Lateral Raises, Front Raises, and Arnold Press.
